description: Six segments that group into envelopes, sequencers and LFOs, the grouping set by which gate inputs are patched: a patched gate starts a group and every unpatched segment to its right joins it

params.text: Sets the curve of that segment when it ramps, the glide when it steps to a level, and the length when it holds
Each press steps that segment between ramping to a level, stepping to a level and waiting for a trigger, and holding a level for a set time; holding the button for a second makes it loop
Sets the time that segment takes when it ramps, and the level it goes to, 0-8V, when it steps or holds

inputs.text: Adds to that segment's slider, 8V covering the whole range
A gate past 1.7V runs the group of segments that begins here, and patching a cable here starts a new group

outputs.text: The envelope of the group that begins at this segment, or, for a segment further into a group, a ramp from 8V down to 0V while that segment is running

notes: a segment with nothing patched into its gate input and no loop set holds its output at 0V.
hold a segment's button for a second to make it loop, which runs it as a free-running LFO; patch a gate into its gate input to run it as an envelope instead.
one looping segment in a group loops on its own, and two mark the start and the end of a looping section; setting a third clears the loop from the other two.
this module has no right-click menu of its own; the segment types and looping are set by the six buttons.
